description.p: Oni's Right Hand is an adventure designed to be an additional quest of Dragon of Icespire Peak in the Essential Kit, and assumes to be played with the Japanese-style characters, released on D&D Japan's official website. However, it can be played with characters made by rules in the Essential Kit or Player's Handbook as well.

This adventure is to be added to the starting quests, which characters undertake in Phandalin. It is merely involved with the main story in the Essential Kit, but the treasures and relations with the NPCs earned in this adventure will adorn the subsequent adventures.

setters.set: This source is derived from an unofficial translation by shiroi_panda_ on note.com. It will be replaced if an official localization is published.

description.p: It's made of purple-dyed leathers and bones of the oni's hand and fingers whittled to plates are sewn with gold threads on backs of hand and fingers. Sharp claws are planted to tips of the fingers. This glove functions with just one hand.

While wearing the glove, any Unarmed Strike you make with the hand is a magical weapon, the damage type changes to Slashing and the damage dice is 1d8. As a Bonus Action, you can also call for the might of Oni and your Strength score becomes 19 for the 10 rounds (1 minute). It has no effect on you if your Strength without it is equal to or greater than that score.

setters.set: strength, unarmed strikes, slashing, damage, bonus action
